parts.text: I plan and run the flights as a dispatcher, which includes deciding which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. I do want help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts. Before and during a flight, outside people and devices report whether the load is ready, if the drone reaches its job points, and when it arrives.
